string.text: We finally made it. The Guide did not deceive me: we really have come to the city of the dead.

I was only a child, and I remember almost nothing. Only screams, tears, and the sound of a siren. Once, this place was home to me and my family. Once... I need to find any clue about my family, my relatives. I would be glad even for a scrap of paper if it could help me remember anything...
